SUBJECT: FT309 MASS TRANSFER IN FOOD PROCESSING
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.

Q1 From  the  first  principle derive  on  equation  to  determine  the  molar  flux.  Apply  this
equation to determine molar flux for steady diffusion A through non diffusing B.

Q5 Soyabean seed are extracted with hexane in batch Extracter. The flaked seed contain
18.6% oil, 69.0% solid and 12.4 % moisture. At the end of the process, cake of milk is
separated from the hexane oil mixture. The cake analysis yield 0.8% oil, 87.7% solid and
11% moisture. Find the % recovery of oil. All % are by wt only.
[5] CO-3 L2
